case_title: CRUZ,JUSTINA VS CHUNG YOON-YI YOUNG-WAN &KWANG CABLE CAR CLEANERS

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $155.00 FILED BY CRUZ,JUSTINA AS TO DEFENDANT CHUNG YOON-YI YOUNG-WAN &KWANG CABLE CAR CLEANERS ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR NOV-15-1993 AT 07:00 PM IN DEPT 01
POS INVAILD SERVICES DONE BY CERTIFIED MAIL BY PLTF. NOT BY COURT.

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF CRUZ,JUSTINA IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT CHUNG YOON-YI YOUNG-WAN &KWANG CABLE CAR CLEANERS STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
